name: Doug Burgum

lean.basis: Republican governor of North Dakota (2016–2024) and 2024 Republican presidential candidate; Trump energy adviser and interior secretary.

current_role: U.S. Secretary of the Interior and chair of the National Energy Dominance Council (since 2025)
summary: Doug Burgum built Great Plains Software, sold it to Microsoft in 2001 for $1.1 billion and stayed on as a Microsoft senior vice president until 2007. He was governor of North Dakota from 2016 to 2024, ran briefly for the 2024 Republican presidential nomination, then advised Trump on energy. He is interior secretary and chairs the National Energy Dominance Council, with Energy Secretary Chris Wright as vice chair.
